name: assurance-assessment-glue
note: Phase 13/C boundary: this workflow handles notification and delivery ONLY. No node here writes to findings.evidence_level or performs severity/confidence logic, that lives in application code (src/domain, an assessment-engine service), called via HTTP nodes below, never reimplemented in n8n expressions.

nodes.name: Intake Received
nodes.notes: Fires when POST /assessments/{id}/intake completes in the application API

nodes.name: Findings Awaiting Review
nodes.notes: Fires when runDiagnostics completes and produces findings at or above the review-required severity threshold, threshold check happens in the application API, not here

nodes.name: Notify Reviewer: Queue Updated
nodes.notes: Sends the reviewer a summary and a link. Does not include a way to mark reviewed from the email, that must go through the authenticated API

nodes.name: Report Ready
nodes.notes: Fires when GET /assessments/{id}/report succeeds and status = report_ready

nodes.name: Deliver Report to Client
nodes.notes: Attaches the generated report, application API is the source of the file, this node only sends it
